args.file_text:
from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user_by_email

def test_handle_get_user_by_email_success():
    params = {"email": "ada@example.com"}
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email(params)
    assert status == 200
    assert result["email"] == "ada@example.com"

def test_handle_get_user_by_email_not_found():
    params = {"email": "nonexistent@example.com"}
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email(params)
    assert status == 404
    assert result == {"error": "not found"}

def test_handle_get_user_by_email_invalid():
    # missing
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({})
    assert status == 400
    # not a string
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123})
    assert status == 400
    # not a plausible email
    status, result = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "not-an-email"})
    assert status == 400
